## Coastal Employee Giving Fund Surpasses $1 Million in Community Grants


November 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/477948498/files/doc_news/Coastal-Employee-Giving-Fund-Surpasses-1-Million-in-Community-Grants-2026.pdf)


Milestone celebrates employees’ commitment to supporting local communities


EVERETT, Wash., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Coastal Community Bank (“coastal”, “our”, “we”, “bank”) announced that the Coastal Employee Giving Fund (the “Fund”) has surpassed $1 million in community grants, marking a significant milestone in employees’ collective commitment to giving back.


The milestone reflects the power of employees coming together around a shared purpose: strengthening the communities where they live and work. Through the fund, that commitment translates into grants that help nonprofit organizations serve their communities and respond to local needs.


“Reaching $1 million in community grants is a meaningful reflection of our employees’ generosity and care for their neighbors,” said Chris Adams, Executive Chair at Coastal Community Bank. “Each grant represents an opportunity to support the organizations doing essential work in our communities. We’re proud of this milestone and grateful to everyone who helped make it possible.”


The Fund was created in 2001 to empower employees to manage charitable giving. A committee of donors meets twice a year to review organizations that support that giving cycle focus area. They review submissions and make grant determinations. Supported entirely by donations contributed by employees and directors, the Fund enables staff to pool their donations for the greatest impact in each community.


“At our Employee Giving Fund's inception, our dollars were small and our hearts were large. As the bank grew, so did our charitable dollars,” said Kaye Phinney, retired Coastal banker, who managed the program for many years. “All employees and directors embraced charitable giving. Surpassing $1 million in grants is a great achievement from our humble beginnings!”


As the fund moves beyond this milestone, Coastal celebrates the employees and nonprofit partners whose commitment turns giving into lasting community impact.


**About Coastal Financial**


Coastal Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: CCB) (the “Company”), is an Everett, Washington based bank holding company whose wholly owned subsidiaries are Coastal Community Bank (“Bank”) and Arlington Olympic LLC. The $5.23 billion Bank provides service through 14 full-service branches in Snohomish, Island and King Counties, one loan production office in King County, the Internet and its mobile banking application. The Bank provides banking as a service to digital financial service providers, companies and brands that want to provide financial services to their customers through the Bank's CCBX segment. To learn more about the Company visit www.coastalbank.com.
